# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a handsome young woman with a plump, showy figure, long yellow braids, brilliant complexion, and large, bright-blue eyes. Prior to her illness, her beauty had a prominent, earthy quality. In her final months, she became very thin, with transparent hands, lustrous blue eyes, and hectically brilliant cheek color.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, good-tempered, and inclined to enjoy the pleasant things of life. She was highly sentimental and obsessed with young men and suitors, often gushing about her romantic conquests. She was also prone to hysterics and crying when startled or upset.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

## Goals

- to teach school for two years before getting married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea and attended school alongside Anne Shirley and their local friends. As a student, she joined a school Story Club and studied for the Queen's Entrance exams with the aim of becoming a teacher. After completing her studies, she was hired to teach at the Carmody school. Rumors often circulated about her numerous admirers and proposals. After contracting galloping consumption following an illness in the winter, she was forced to stop teaching, though she maintained plans to take the White Sands school in the autumn. She passed away quietly in her sleep during the summer break.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v3 c8 P3](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0003), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
